stories.title: Define Map Provider Data Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and document the frontend data contract for map rendering including lat/long, provider_id, name, specialty, and optional metadata (address, distance). Ensure strict alignment with provider search outputs and validation rules.

stories.title: Implement Provider-to-Map Transformation Logic
stories.description: Implement transformation layer converting provider search results into map marker objects, including coordinate validation, null filtering, and deduplication based on provider_id.

stories.title: Build Interactive Map Component
stories.description: Develop reusable frontend map component supporting marker rendering, clustering (if needed), zoom/pan controls, and click interactions displaying provider summary कार्ड.

stories.title: Bind Map to Live Provider Search Results
stories.description: Integrate map component with live provider search flow so markers update dynamically based on user queries, filters, and location context within the chat application.

stories.title: Map Rendering and Interaction Test Suite
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering marker rendering accuracy, coordinate edge cases, user interactions (click, zoom), and synchronization with provider search updates.
